instruction: You are given an external-flow template `/home/user/Desktop/plate_base/`. Complete a flat-plate boundary-layer analysis from the command line: 1. Modify and create `/home/user/Desktop/plate/`: - Build a zero-thickness flat plate on the bottom edge of a rectangular domain, starting downstream of the leading edge - Set inflow conditions and laminar fluid properties - Run until the boundary layer is fully developed 2. Extract wall shear stress and convert it to friction coefficient. 3. Write a post-processing script to output `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt`: - Friction coefficient `cf` at the specified station - Percentage error against theoretical value `error_percent` - Format: `cf, error_percent` 4. Do not use GUI tools.
